title: YouAlert
intro:
Have you noticed anything suspicious? Unusual presences, scam attempts, people lurking in the area or other incidents that might be worth reporting?
Write it here: sharing information can help everyone be more careful and protect one another.
pushAsk: Want a phone notification for every new alert?
pushDenied: Notifications blocked: enable them in browser settings.
pushIframe: Notifications only work on the published site.
disclaimer: ⚠️ Warning: the reports on YouAlert come from users and may sometimes be unverified. Use them with caution and always refer to official sources.
maxPhotos: You can attach at most 2 photos
